title: tupistra macrostigma
intro: Tupistra macrostigma, commonly known as the Giant White Lilyturf, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia, characterized by its distinctive white flowers and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Tupistra macrostigma include its potential in treating inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. Bioactive constituents present in Tupistra macrostigma include compounds such as 9-hydroxy-4-hydroxy-3-(4-methoxyphenyl)-2H-1-benzopyran-2-one and 3-hydroxy-4-methoxyphenyl-2H-1-benzopyran-2-one, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
